listed_sector_signals.signal: Oil refinery used as the empirical case study for applying the resource-utilization / energy-management-system evaluation approach
listed_sector_signals.quote: In addition, an oil refinery is considered as a case study.

listed_sector_signals.signal: The proposed approach is applied to an oil refinery implementing an energy management system
listed_sector_signals.quote:
In this section, the proposed approach is applied to a case study of an oil refinery that intends to
implement an EnMS.

one_line: The paper proposes an approach to evaluate resource utilization within an ISO 50001 energy management system and applies it empirically to an oil refinery case study, focusing on organizational/human/document resources rather than the production process itself.
